title: Design System: Agent Workbench Dispatch Ledger

display.purpose: The single primary heading at the top of a workspace.

label.purpose: Compact labels and controls that must remain clear in dense panes.

mono.purpose: Tool arguments and unstructured structured-result fallbacks.

shadows.name: ambient-surface
shadows.purpose: Sticky composer, contextual fields, and broader elevated surfaces in light theme.

shadows.name: close-surface
shadows.purpose: Scenario ledger, inspector, decision, review, and memory containers in light theme.

shadows.name: ambient-surface-dark
shadows.purpose: System-dark replacement for the larger ambient surface shadow.

shadows.name: close-surface-dark
shadows.purpose: System-dark replacement for the close surface shadow.

motion.name: ledger-ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for interactive state transitions and entry motion.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Navigation and button color, border, shadow, and transform feedback.

motion.name: skeleton-breathe
motion.purpose: Alternate opacity treatment for list loading skeletons.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: System reduced-motion override for transitions and animations.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Filled vermilion action for sending, saving, confirming, and other explicit writes.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid var(--vermilion); border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 13px; color: #fffaf6; background: var(--vermilion); font: 750 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .25, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .25, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .25, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .25, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--vermilion-strong); background: var(--vermilion-strong); box-shadow: 0 7px 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--vermilion) 25%, transparent); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Outlined, non-writing action for refreshing, clearing, or inspecting without competing with the primary decision.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 13px; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; font: 750 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .25, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .25, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .25, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--jade); color: var(--jade-strong); background: var(--jade-soft); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--surface-strong); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Operational Field
components.description: A quiet bounded field for session context and decision answers.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font: 750 0.82rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 10px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); caret-color: var(--vermilion); font: 400 0.9rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--jade); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Graphite desktop navigation that makes the current workspace an unambiguous persistent state.
components.css: .ds-workspace-nav { display: grid; gap: 5px; width: 216px; padding: 14px; color: var(--rail-ink); background: var(--rail); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 11px; color: var(--rail-muted); background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .25, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .25, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .25, 1); } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-item strong, .ds-nav-item small { display: block; } .ds-nav-item strong { font: 650 0.93rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item small { margin-top: 3px; font: 400 0.72rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--rail-ink); background: rgb(239 241 232 / 8%); } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--rail-ink); background: #526658; box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Small semantic witness for a running, completed, or failed operational state.
components.html: 运行中已完成需要重试
components.css: .ds-status-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 8px; font: 800 0.72rem/1 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-running { color: var(--warning); background: var(--warning-soft); } .ds-status-success { color: var(--success); background: var(--success-soft); } .ds-status-error { color: var(--vermilion); background: var(--vermilion-soft); }

components.name: Scenario Ledger
components.description: Grouped quick-start scenarios separated by internal rules, rather than a row of unrelated cards.
components.css: .ds-scenario-ledger { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgb(33 43 36 / 9%); } .ds-scenario { display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 122px; align-items: flex-start; gap: 11px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 17px 15px; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-scenario:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-scenario:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); } .ds-scenario:active { background: var(--surface-strong); } .ds-scenario:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-scenario-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; color: var(--jade); } .ds-scenario strong, .ds-scenario small { display: block; } .ds-scenario strong { font: 650 0.92rem/1.3 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-scenario small { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--muted); font: 500 0.78rem/1.45 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Conversation Turn
components.description: The paired request-and-response record that makes an Agent round read as one coherent piece of work.

components.css: .ds-turn { padding: 25px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); animation: ds-reveal-turn 230ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .25, 1) both; } .ds-turn-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 11px; } .ds-turn-response { margin-top: 22px; } .ds-avatar { display: grid; width: 30px; height: 30px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--surface); font: 800 0.73rem/1 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-avatar-user { background: var(--jade); } .ds-avatar-agent { background: var(--rail); } .ds-turn-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 0.78rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-turn-meta strong { color: var(--ink); font-size: 0.84rem; } .ds-turn p { max-width: 74ch; margin: 6px 0 0; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-route { display: inline-flex; margin: 9px 0 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--jade-strong); background: var(--jade-soft); font: 750 0.74rem/1 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } @keyframes ds-reveal-turn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(7px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-turn { animation-duration: 1ms; } }

components.description: A muted business-result record with an explicit jade label and rule-divided fields.

ORDER-PAID-001

199.00

components.css: .ds-structured-card { margin-top: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-muted); font-family: Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-structured-card > strong { display: block; color: var(--jade-strong); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-field-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin: 12px 0 0; } .ds-field-list div { min-width: 0; padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-field-list dt { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field-list dd { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 650; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-field-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

components.name: Decision Card
components.description: Shared confirmation frame for Workflow questions and ReAct tool-write intervention.
components.html:
确认工具写入

将当前会话偏好保存为“回答时优先简洁”。
components.css: .ds-decision-card { margin-top: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--jade); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgb(33 43 36 / 9%); font-family: Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-decision-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 11px; } .ds-decision-icon { width: 22px; height: 22px; flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--vermilion); fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-decision-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-decision-heading p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.82rem; } .ds-decision-copy { margin: 16px 0 0; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-decision-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-decision-primary, .ds-decision-secondary { border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 13px; font: 750 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-decision-primary { border: 1px solid var(--vermilion); color: #fffaf6; background: var(--vermilion); } .ds-decision-primary:hover { background: var(--vermilion-strong); } .ds-decision-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); color: var(--ink); background: transparent; } .ds-decision-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--jade); color: var(--jade-strong); background: var(--jade-soft); } .ds-decision-primary:focus-visible, .ds-decision-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-inspector { overflow: hidden; width: min(340px, 100%); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgb(33 43 36 / 9%); font-family: Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-inspector-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 17px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-muted); } .ds-inspector-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-inspector-heading p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.78rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-inspector-heading span { border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--warning); background: var(--warning-soft); font: 800 0.72rem/1 Aptos, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-trace-list { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 17px; margin: 0; padding: 21px 17px 24px; list-style: none; } .ds-trace-list::before { position: absolute; top: 32px; bottom: 34px; left: 31px; width: 1px; background: var(--line); content: ''; } .ds-trace-list li { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; } .ds-trace-list i { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--jade); background: var(--surface); font-style: normal; } .ds-trace-list i svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-trace-list strong { font-size: 0.82rem; } .ds-trace-list time { float: right; color: var(--quiet); font-size: 0.72rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-trace-list p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.overview:
Dispatch Ledger makes an Agent round feel like a legible work record rather than a generic SaaS dashboard. A graphite rail holds stable workspace orientation; the mineral canvas keeps requests, structured results, and forms calm enough to read for long sessions. Jade marks the selected workspace, chosen route, and healthy workflow movement. Vermilion is deliberately reserved for actions that write, confirm, cancel, or fail.

This is a personal, local school-recruitment workbench. Its visual confidence comes from clear boundaries, real state, and a restrained amount of polish—not production claims, decorative metrics, neon, or a log-viewer aesthetic. The desktop conversation canvas and its narrow execution inspector are peers: the former explains the business round, while the latter preserves technical evidence on demand.
keyCharacteristics: Dense but breathable operational reading, with persistent context and short, bounded panes.
Mineral surfaces, graphite navigation, jade progress, and sparingly used vermilion actions.
Rounded rectangular records with thin dividers and ambient, low-contrast elevation.
System light and dark palettes, plus mobile stacked panes rather than compressed desktop columns.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Jade means selected, routed, or advancing; vermilion means write, confirm, cancel, fail, or delete. Do not use either simply to decorate a neutral surface.

rules.name: The System-Theme Rule
rules.body: The CSS custom-property names remain semantic in dark mode; their values change with the system preference so content and state roles never change meaning.

rules.name: The Reading-First Rule
rules.body: Use the large display treatment once per workspace; let section headings, labels, and metadata do the rest of the hierarchy without adding ornamental type styles.

rules.name: The Ledger-Not-Glass Rule
rules.body: Tonal boundaries and fine rules establish most depth. Blur is limited to the two sticky context layers; do not turn ordinary cards into frosted glass.

rules.name: The Shared-Record Rule
rules.body: Use a single rounded outer boundary for related data or actions, then divide its interior with rules. Do not give every item an independently floating card.

dos: **Do** keep the graphite rail on desktop and use the mobile bottom navigation below 720px.
**Do** assign jade to selection, routing, and affirmative workflow visibility; assign vermilion to write, confirm, cancel, failure, and deletion.
**Do** use the defined compact controls, fine rules, and shared outer containers to keep dense operational data legible.
**Do** honor system light/dark themes, visible focus outlines, reduced-motion behavior, and the forced-colors fallback.
**Do** keep state feedback within the existing quick 150–250ms range and preserve static readability when it is disabled.
donts: **Don't** introduce blue SaaS gradients, neon accents, fabricated metrics, or production-service claims.
**Don't** make every row or field a floating card; group related records inside one bordered surface.
**Don't** use jade and vermilion as interchangeable decoration or hide state solely in color.
**Don't** compress the desktop rail-plus-inspector layout into a narrow mobile column; stack panes and retain the bottom navigation.
**Don't** add prolonged animation, parallax, or ambient movement to an operational workspace.
